name: Retro
description: 1980s character-generator look: pale-yellow and white text in a blocky terminal face with hard shadows, no boxes, cut-on and typed-on reveals. Scorebug, batter / pitcher ID, due up, lineup, linescore, final, standings, matchup, custom lines, ticker and a scan-line transition.
